items.title: Bob Coquille Interview, 1978-11-20
items.q: T. Gordon and everybody else, and Sharky and all the good bands.

ctx.x: So I would say about six years, seven, maybe close to seven years. Well, I'll be very honest with you, Dick. I played string bass about 37 years, and I always did like bass. I love string bass, and I love electric bass also. What I like about guitar bass, being an old guitar player myself, guitar bass came a little easier to me than I thought it would. And I find it to be very clean in playing, and I don't have to lug that big bass fiddle around. And I always did like it, but I was, even when I played string…
Well, does it change your plan?
